allowSame.sqm.linkDiffieHellman: Diffie-Hellman is an invariant eponym pair per 06-GLOSSARY.md section (d); 'Key Exchange' is the sibling tool's generic descriptor, kept identical across languages to match the invariant naming convention already used for the tool's own proper-noun form.
allowSame.sqm.baseLabel: French/Spanish/Italian/Portuguese 'base' is spelled identically to English 'base' (06-GLOSSARY.md term 32); 'Base b' is therefore genuinely identical in those languages (Italian added by quick task 261002-c77; Brazilian and European Portuguese added by quick task 261002-jh4).
allowSame.sqm.expLabel: Dutch/German/Swedish/Romanian 'exponent'/'Exponent' is spelled identically to English 'exponent' (06-GLOSSARY.md term 31); 'Exponent e' is therefore genuinely identical in those languages.
allowSame.sqm.modLabel: Dutch/Hungarian 'modulus' is spelled identically to English 'modulus' (06-GLOSSARY.md term 10); 'Modulus m' is therefore genuinely identical in those languages.
allowSame.sqm.headingAccumulator: Dutch computing vocabulary borrows 'accumulator' unchanged from English.
allowSame.sqm.mulBase: French/Spanish 'base' is spelled identically to English 'base'; the template '× base = {0}' holds no other prose word.
allowSame.sqm.stepSquareFormula: The template itself is pure math notation ('mod', '=') plus param placeholders — the translatable word lives in the separate lblSquare key supplied as param {0}, so the template string is identical in every language by design.
allowSame.sqm.stepMultiplyFormula: The template itself is pure math notation ('×', 'mod', '=') plus param placeholders — the translatable words live in the separate lblMultiplyBitOne key supplied as param {0}, so the template string is identical in every language by design.

allowLiteral.brisk: JS-owned speed word (06-02 pattern): overwritten synchronously on load by renderSpeedLabel() (translate('common.speed.' + speedInput.value)) before first paint. The static markup value is never what a user actually sees.
JS-owned #banner intro text: overwritten by rebuild() (bannerState = {key:'sqm.bannerComputed', ...}) on every load, since the page auto-computes on load. The static markup value is never what a user actually sees.
allowLiteral.▶ Play: JS-owned playback button: overwritten synchronously by renderPlayPauseLabel() inside rebuild() on every load, before first paint. The static markup value is never what a user actually sees.
allowLiteral.JetBrains Mono, Consolas, monospace: CSS font-family value passed as an SVG text-element attribute (svgEl 'font-family'), not prose.

allowRenderText.Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange: Same invariant proper-noun rationale as the allowSame entry above — the rendered link text is identical to English in every language.
allowRenderText.Base b: French/Spanish/Italian/Portuguese 'base' is a cognate of English 'base' (06-GLOSSARY.md term 32) — the rendered label is genuinely identical (Italian added by quick task 261002-c77; Brazilian and European Portuguese added by quick task 261002-jh4).
allowRenderText.Exponent e: Dutch/German/Swedish/Romanian 'exponent' is a cognate of English 'exponent' (06-GLOSSARY.md term 31) — the rendered label is genuinely identical.
allowRenderText.Modulus m: Dutch/Hungarian 'modulus' is a cognate of English 'modulus' (06-GLOSSARY.md term 10) — the rendered label is genuinely identical.
allowRenderText.accumulator: Dutch computing vocabulary borrows 'accumulator' unchanged from English (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check).
